PRODUCTIONS
CURRENT AND UPCOMING
The Open Couple
Presented by The Italian Institute of Culture, we were absolutely thrilled to return to the stage with a Dario Fo’s timeless piece.
Waitress On Top
The opera adaptation of La Serva Padrona by Giovanni Pergolesi has toured local schools exposing students to Commedia Dell’Arte and Italian Culture.
Educational Workshops
Our teachers have been very busy bringing dramatic material and performances to schools; to see the students blossoming into their characters and performance was a true blessing for us to witness!
Acting classes for adults
Our students have just wrapped up their final performance after a 10-week acting course. Bummed that you missed it? Fear not. We have more classes coming up in the new year- including a complementary class anyone can try out before the course.  Click here for more details.
Murder Mystery Dinner Theatre and Quiz Nights
We have presented a selection of Murder Mystery Dinner Theatre at hotels in Hong Kong, and we regularly host Quiz nights at Grain in Kennedy Town. We work in partnership with different clients to offer a different range of entertainment for a fun night out.
Murder Mysteries  and Escape Room for the classroom
We don’t only present workshops in schools, but we have a range of interactive programmes to engage students and help them develop creative skills and critical thinking.
.
How’s 2023 looking? 🙂
